class.name: YAMLResult
class.brief_description: Contains the results or errors from YAML operations.
class.description: Contains the results from YAML parsing or stringifying operations, providing a unified interface for both successful data and error cases. This class serves as a return type for API methods, containing either the parsed/stringified data or error information. [YAMLResult] objects are immutable and can contain either successful data or error information, but not both. When an operation succeeds, the result contains the data and no error. When an operation fails, the result contains error information and empty data. Multi-document YAML is fully supported, allowing you to access each document individually through [method get_document] or [method get_data] with an index parameter.

method.name: error
method.description: Creates an error result with the specified error message. Useful for validation when deserializing custom classes (see [method YAML.register_class] for details).

method.name: get_data
get_document
method.description: Alias for [method get_data] for clarity when working with multiple documents.

method.name: get_document_count
method.description: Returns the number of documents in the result. Returns [code]0[/code] for error results.

method.name: get_error
method.description: Returns a formatted error string including message, line number, and column number.

method.name: get_error_column
method.description: Returns the column number where the error occurred. Returns [code]-1[/code] if not applicable.

method.name: get_error_line
method.description: Returns the line number where the error occurred. Returns [code]-1[/code] if not applicable.

method.name: get_error_message
method.description: Returns the raw error message without line and column information.

method.name: get_style
method.description: Returns the style information if any. Only available if style detection was enabled during parsing (see [method YAML.parse] and [method YAML.load_file]).

method.name: has_error
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the result contains an error, [code]false[/code] otherwise.

method.name: has_style
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the result contains style information, [code]false[/code] otherwise.
